The season, named "Dr. [[Tabaré Vázquez]]" after the late former President of Uruguay and chairman of [[C.A. Progreso|Progreso]] from 1979 to 1989, started on 15 May and ended on 7 December 2021, with the starting date having been pushed back from early 2021 due to the late conclusion of the previous season owing to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |url=https://www.elobservador.com.uy/nota/-como-se-juega-el-uruguayo-de-primera-en-la-temporada-2021-y-cuando-comienza--2021329153630|title=¿Cómo se juega el Uruguayo de Primera en la temporada 2021 y |url=https://www.futbol.com.uy/Deportes/Campeonato-Uruguayo-2021-se-denominara-Dr-Tabare-Vazquez-y-comenzara-el-8-de-mayo-uc783752|title=Campeonato Uruguayo 2021 se denominará "Dr. Tabaré Vázquez" y the Torneo Clausura and placing first in the season's aggregate table and then beating Torneo Apertura winners [[Club Plaza Colonia de Deportes|Plaza Colonia]] on penalties in the semi-final played on 7 December.{{cite web |url=https://www.futbol.com.uy/Deportes/Penarol-vencio-8-7-a-Plaza-Colonia-en-penales-y-es-el-nuevo-campeon-del-futbol-uruguayo-uc806397|title=Peñarol venció 8-7 a Plaza Colonia en penales y es el nuevo campeón del fútbol uruguayo|publisher=Futbol.com.uy|language=es|date=7 December 2021|access-date=7 December 2021}} [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] were the defending champions. ==Format changes== For the 2021 season, the competition was scheduled to run for eight months, from May to December, and had a change from the previous editions with the elimination of the Torneo Intermedio which is usually played midway into the season and adds seven matchdays to the league schedule. This change was intended to leave extra time available to finish the season before the end of the year in the event the health emergency caused by the COVID-19 pandemic forced any suspension of matches in the course of the season. With that change, clubs only played 15 matches in the Torneo Apertura and 15 matches in the Torneo Clausura, for a total of 30 matches in the season, as well as the ones belonging to the Championship playoff for the clubs that eventually qualified for it.
